His name is Fein Lu Lugus. He is a Warlock by trade, and he was in Sayak, Celesta, in the Six Kingdoms Alliance.{wait}{clear}He appears to travel the land carrying out all manner of work on commission from the Guild of mages.{wait}{clear}He also possesses a vast store of knowledge, and seems especially well versed in magic and history.{wait}{clear}I am certain he will assist you, Angel, so why not go and meet him without delay?

His name is Clive Saingrent.{wait}{clear}He is a vampire hunter by trade, and he was in Leszno, Slatina, in the Duchy of Courrege.{wait}{clear}He takes commissions to slay undead from towns and villages on the frontier, and judging by the trust he enjoys there, his skill is genuine.{wait}{clear}Something shadowy about him gives me pause, but why not meet him first?

His name is Rudiere Trier Legrance. He is the second prince of the Kingdom of Legrance.{wait}{clear}He was in Fanlan, the capital of the Kingdom of Legrance, in Ellora.{wait}{clear}Despite his position as a prince, he takes no part whatsoever in affairs of state, and appears to spend every day at play.{wait}{clear}There seems to be some reason for it, but regrettably I could not learn that much.{wait}{clear}Still, I sensed in him more strength than he knows what to do with, and a very strong curiosity.{wait}{clear}So I am certain he will be a help to you, Angel. Why not go and meet him?

His name is Rocus Las Flores. He was in Araras, the capital of the Holy Nation of Ecclesia, in Linares.{wait}{clear}He is a clergyman, and I heard he rightfully holds the rank of Pope. However, he appears to have distanced himself from the Church for now.{wait}{clear}I certainly sensed a very mysterious power in him. So I believe he will be a help to you, Angel. Why not go and meet him?

Her name is Irene Tirnag. She is a young mage girl living in Darg on Bremes Isle.{wait}{clear}She lives all alone in a tower, and devotes herself every day to the pursuit of magical knowledge.{wait}{clear}I sense very strong magic in her, so I am sure she will do great things as a hero. Why not go and meet her?

Her name is Leyla Vigrid. She is in Reizefut, the capital of the Grosain Empire, in Reizefut.{wait}{clear}They say she is the Empire's first female knight, skilled enough with the sword to be entrusted with an order of knights, and she seems to have enjoyed her men's deep trust.{wait}{clear}However, though I could not learn the details, she is now imprisoned.{wait}{clear}I cannot believe she has done anything wrong. Angel, would you please help her?

Her name is Cecia. She was in Leiria, Fes, in the untamed lands.{wait}{clear}She is a girl of the clan that lives in the Reyforia Forest, which spreads across the untamed lands, and she is exceptionally skilled with a bow.{wait}{clear}She is also pure, with a strong sense of justice, and she seems to hold a very strong admiration for angels.{wait}{clear}Therefore I am certain she will help you, Angel. Why not go and meet her?

Angel, Leyla Vigrid, whom we found as a hero candidate, has gone missing.{wait}{clear}It appears to be because her mother in Reizefut, the Empire's capital, has passed away. We have no idea at all where Leyla-sama is...{wait}{clear}It is a great shame, but one of Arcaya's hopes has been lost.

Angel! The Empire invaded Alkmaar in Basel and destroyed the Grand Lodge, the heart of the Guild.{wait}{clear}I believe this will have a very serious effect on every country.{wait}{clear}It also appears that something very important has fallen into the Empire's hands.{wait}{clear}Stopping the Empire's invasion may be difficult even for the heroes, but please take care that the chaos level does not rise.
